Un'kyɔm kàkäl kan'tol uboboo, Yɛsu kàbeenà ndwà a Nzam, waa kàlɔɔŋà.
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « An'lɔɔŋ amɛ kà man'fà akà mɛ anki, wɛɛ màmbuur kan'töm.
Iköŋ a baar kyun'fuur naa: « Ngye awe anà un'sɔŋà! Nà akwen akadwa? ».
Ilä a ntsüü a un'kyɔm kyàkäl ilä mwɛy kyà kölàköl. Yɛsu kàkäl umbär wàmukyäänà naa: « Isàkal naa mbuur we anà mfwää, wɛy nde uyi akà mɛ, waa unwà.
Ntɔn nkye mpa làkayöbà bɛ ntɛɛn amɛ? Ntɔn bɛ, bɛ làkwe anki muwem ndaa amɛ.
Ayudà waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Nkye ngye akà mbul an'kwem an'tyeen awe ayà, waa ngye kàmɛn Abàlam! ».
Baar a tsütsü anà nde anà baar bàfun'manà kusà wàmulɔlɔm, bàfuulà naa: « Nkye wà kà mbuur akwà kàkälà wà aŋàbwaay anà kàfalɔ̈lɔ̈mà anki? ».
Baal waa kàtɛn naa: « Mwol, mɛ, mɛ an'sà làkwikilà. » Apan, nde kàbü an'köm kusà a Yɛsu.
Kyekà, Bɛtanya làkäl tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, kà isii a an'kilɔmɛtre an'tär.
Nde kàfuur naa: « Inye, Mwol, mɛ an'sà làkwikilà naa ngye awà Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam awasàyà pà u mɛɛn. ».
Nde kàkyer ayöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa nà kàlun'yälà, undiir awun kàtɛn nde naa: « Kà bɛ banswà anki làbà aŋàpɔŋà. ».
Isàkal naa bɛ lan'kwen bɛ a bɛ, apan, baar banswà bàsàyöb naa bɛ làbà alɔŋki amɛ. ».
wɛɛ, ntɔn naa mɛɛn màyöb naa mɛ in'kwen Taa, anà mɛ in'fàkyer nswɛɛŋ kan'pɛ Taa. Làmbarà, tsweenà!.
Abun, kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r Pilatu kàyaman u nsà, waa kafuul naa: « Undiir nà lan'füün bɛ mbuur wà? ».

Apan, Pilatu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Iswaŋà naa ngye awà mfum? » Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Ngye an'tɛn ngye ŋakwo naa mɛ in'wà mfum. Mɛ, bàkyer an'bɔr, waa mɛ kàyi u mɛɛn ntɔn mutà imbäl akà ndandaa. Mbuur wanswà awunsà ndandaa afàwem ndaa amɛ. » –.
Ungö mutɛn abà, nde kamɛɛy an'kɔɔ anà bɛl a nsyäärà ande. Alɔŋki banswà bàkäl unsà un'sak muman Mwol.
Mpal bàwem ba làso alan, un'sɛŋ wanswà kàyi u ntiin. Ba bàkäl mubem, ntɔn mbuur mbuur kàweemà u ndaa ande ŋakwo bàtɛɛnà ba.

Kyekà ilä byanswà ba bàfatwaalà ŋatoo mwɛy sɛmà mböör ande, waa bàfun'tɔɔlà u munàmbwo a ndwà a Nzam tsütsü a ibeenà bàfàbel naa « La Bɛɛl Pɔrte » ntɔn nde ulɔ̈ɔ̈mà ngim akà baar bàfabilà u ndwà a Nzam.
Wɛɛ u bul alan kàfwel anà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Simɔn. Nde kàfakyerà inwɛŋ anà kàbemà ngwal un'sɛŋ a Samàlya. Nde kakyeyà uyɔl naa nde mpɛl awà mbuur a kölàköl.
Abaal kàyilyaaŋà nde abà, bàkyer atsum mun, ba bàweemà ndaa, wɛɛ ba mbuur bàmɛn anki.
Wɛɛ Mwol kàtɛn a nde naa: « Kyen, ntɔn mbuur awà mɛ amun'sɔɔl asànaa un'syääl amɛ musyen ikɔb amɛ kusà a baar mpa abà Ayudà, kusà a amfum anà kusà a baan a Isàlɛl.
Mpal kan'kɔlà nde u Yɛlusàlɛm, Sɔl kàsi mutüüb anà alɔŋki. Wɛɛ ba banswà bàkäl u bɔɔmà, ntɔn ba bàkyey anki naa nde akyàbulà un'lɔŋki ndandaa.
Abun, Banàbasi waa kun'wɛl, kun'syen akà Antööm, waa kasam ndaa kàmɛn Sɔl Mwol u mbwo anà kàyääm nde anà nde. Nde kasam sye naa Sɔl kàlɔŋ anà uyɔl kà ikɔb a Yɛsu u Damas.
Antööm anà atↄŋ bàkäl u Yuday bàwem naa baar mpa abà Ayudà sye ban'wal Ndaa a Nzam.
Ntɔn nde kàkäl mbuur mwԑy wàŋàbwaŋ, wàŋàyↄl a Dweelà In'kyɛԑl anà làkwikilà. Apan, un'kàbɔ a baar kàyàtüüb anà Mwol.

Apan ba bàlyaaŋ ikal a nseey kyàtàtwԑb, bàfàlyaaŋ kyàyweel, waa bàtöl u munàmbwo awe anà ibeenà a in'naan ifàler mper a bul. Ibeenà aki kyàdubà kya ŋakwo kusà a ba. Ba waa bàtoo, bàyikyeenà u balàbal làmwey. Apan, un'kyeey kàsun'wɛy kà imbürà.
Nzam kun'wiiy uboo a akü, ntɔn nde ukɔↄn afàfurà unsà upɔɔn. Abun nde kàtԑn naa: Mԑ in'sàlapà indiir in'kyɛԑl anà byàndandaa kàbön mɛ mupà David.
Undiir awun kàfàtԑn nde kà itiir a ndaa asin: Ngye asàpà anki mbwo naa mbuur angye wà in'kyɛԑl upɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Wԑԑ mpal bàwem baar mpa abà Ayudà ndaa ayi, ba bàmɛn un'sak, ba bàsɛmà musà ndaa a Mwol làkoo. Baar banswà basɔ̈ɔ̈l muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, ba bàsi làkwikilà.
Akun sye, ba bàkäl mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ.
Ungö bàlↄŋ ba baar Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ u bul alà anà baar mbↄↄn bàbulà ba alↄŋki, ba bàfurà Listre, Ikↄn anà Antyↄsha.
Wɛɛ, ntɔn ngyɛb a Mwol Yɛsu awà ifàsà bi làkwikilà, bi kàwü mɔ̈ɔ̈ sye asànaa ba. ».
Ungö ban'taŋ ba wa, atɔŋ bàmɛn un'sak, ntɔn wa kapɛ ngwal.
Dwelà In'kyɛɛl kàkyer atsuŋ mukyään Ndaa u mɛɛn a Azi, abun ba bàsoonà nsi a Filizi anà Ngalàtyà.
Wɛɛ ndam a baar bumwɛy bàbääb anà nde, ba bàsi làkwikilà: uboo a ba, Dɛnis mbuur a Arɔbazɛ, anà un'kaar mwɛy ikɔb ande Damalis, anà baar asin sye.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbaaŋ yà ntɔn ndaa anà ikɔb anà un'kɔɔn abɛ ŋakwo, ayin iler bɛ ŋakwo. Mɛ, mɛ in'kwen anki mukal ntɛɛn a indiir abi! ».
Ba bàtöl Ԑfɛsɔ, Pɔl kàsàwɛy atɔŋ bàkäl anà nde paa. Nde kàbilà nde ŋakwo u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa kàyäm anà Ayudà.
Pɔl kàkwen mukàmɛnà kusà a un'sɛŋ, wɛɛ alɔŋki waa bun'tsüŋ.
Kà imbürà, baar bàlun'kam an'füm ntɔn nde usi ndaa, waa bàtɛ upay. Wɛɛ mfum a nsaab kàwem bɔɔmà naa kyekà mbuur kàbäm nde in'siŋ wà, wà un'lɔmà.
Apan ba bàyan'man u ndwà a Nzam ungö a mpɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ amɛ: akà nköŋ mwɛy itàkal làso làmwɛy làkäl anki.
Ungö a ilä itär a ngyeel ande kà itiir a nsi akin, Fɛstüs kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm fà Sɛzarɛ.
Umpal kàbeenà mɛ Yɛlusàlɛm, amfum a angaŋ anà andweer a Ayudà bàkyer ayà mukun'füün, ba bàkwen naa bun'dwä ndwà.
Taaŋtyà, Angilipà anà Bɛrnis bàyi unsà làso lanswà, waa bàbilà u làbay a nsaŋ mbwo mwɛy anà amfum a nsaab anà abyääl a bul. Fɛstüs kàswɛŋ naa bun'twääl Pɔl.
Akun, kaptɛn kàmɛn an'swà a Alɛksandri màmukyà Itali, laa kibiil nde.
Ntɔn, kà ndaa ifàmɛnà u mii anki ifàkyer Un'yudà, itàkal idiim ifàmɛnà u ndür kyan'kyer nkyɛɛy.
Isàkal naa Abàlam bun'twey balàbal u mbwo a isal ande, nde kàlàkal anà ngyal musɛn an'pɛy, wɛɛ kà kusà a Nzam anki.

Ungö amukun'pà, ba bun'si isii a nkyɛɛy asànaa inyɛm a balàbal kàwɛl nde u mbwo a làkwikilà, utaaŋ kàkäl nde ŋàtun'kyɛy anki. Kyakin awà nde taa a baar banswà mpa abàŋàkyɛy, ntɔn ba sye bàbulà baar a balàbal.
Nde bàkyer un'kab ntɔn ibii abi, waa kàwiyà ntɔn mutwey bi bàbalàbal.
Wɛɛ bi bàfuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam: kusà bɛ làkäl asɔ a man'be, wɛɛ apanà, bɛ làkyàkyey u mpem abɛ wanswà an'lɔɔŋ a kiin amà bàlapɛ.

Abà, isàkal naa nde kan'wal un'dim asin utaaŋ awà mbuur awà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, nde kan'tà inswem. Wɛɛ, isàkal naa un'dim kan'kwà, nde kan'bulà nsaay kusà a un'kɔɔn, apan nde uyàkal anki ŋinswem mubulà un'kyay a mbuur asin.
Ntɔn man'be, u mbwo nsil ayin, laa man'kür ma, u mbwo a nswɛɛŋ, anà u mbwo a wa, waa kan'pɛ ukwà.
Ntɔn un'sön afàsyen kà ukwà, wɛɛ Dweelà afàsyen u mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà u duu.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa bɛ làbà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ unsà imbuur, bɛ làkyer asàkwà, wɛɛ isàkal naa unsà Dweelà, bɛ lan'dwa nkääl abɛ yà imbuur, apan bɛ làsàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.

Ntɔn bi kàkyàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ya yà unsà làkyän mpɛl. Abun, làkyän imanà bi là la kà làkyän anki. Kyekà, uman undiir bàsyeelà làkyän ifàkal nsyeel a làkyän anki: làkyän bàfàsà aben unsà undiir akamɛnà?.
Nà asatsüül mbar? Klistɔ Yɛsu kàkyàkwà, waa kàfàwiyà, nde wà u kɔɔ a ibaal a Nzam, wàmubɔɔn ntɔn bi!.
Wɛɛ unsà ayi yanswà, bi ibà aŋàböŋ aŋàsöönà u mbwo a mbuur awà kikwen.
Abun, mbuur asàbel ikɔb a Mwol akyer asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Apan, mɛ in'fuul naa: Nkye ba bàwem anki? Ɛɛ, bàkyàwem! Ntɔn, bàsön naa: « Làböl aba làpää u mɛɛn manswà, ndaa aba yàtöl tii u ntsüü a mɛɛn. ».
Ntɔn, isàkal naa Nzam kàtii anki an'kɔkà màfàtoo ma ŋakwo, kal kà igyɛɛŋ, manà nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n asatii, akà ikikye!.
Làsaak baar abà bàfàlamɛɛy nkwaaŋ: lasaak, twon lasi in'küül.
Ngye, ngye awà nà mutsüül un'syääl abar nsaŋ? Itàkal naa nde wàŋàtsim, itàkal naa nde wàŋàbwà, ntɔn Mwol we anà ikɔ̈b mukun'mbaar.
Wɛɛ mɛ kàsi ibyääl mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ nà kà ikal mpa bàkäl aŋàtàtà ikɔb a Klistɔ din, ntɔn mukɔɔn atɔŋ udu a in'bään kàsi mbuur asin.
Baar banswà bàkyàyöb unkyeey abɛ. Lalan mɛ in'wà unsà un'sak ntɔn bɛ, wɛɛ mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ làkäl aŋan'yeerà ntɔn ubwaŋ anà ankɔr ntɔn ube.
Abun, wàken ŋan'yeerà? Wàken un'lɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn? Wàken un'yweer a taaŋ alà? Nkye Nzam kàbuul anki an'yeerà a mɛɛn ukɔŋ?.
Mɛ amàlapà an'bɛɛl munwà, kà isaa a bwoor anki, ntɔn bɛ làlàkwo anki anà bya. Itàkal apanà, bɛ làkwo anki.
Ndandaa, an'kyän amɛ mà a duu, wɛɛ wa kà undiir atwey mɛ wàbalàbal anki. Mwol wà mbuur atsüül mɛ nsaŋ.
Kyekà, muyweer naa mɛ in'yàyà anki akà bɛ, amwɛy uboo abɛ bàyööl a uyɔl.
Mɛ kàlasöön unsà un'kaan amɛ naa twon lan'kal un'tüüb anà baar bàfàkyer ndaa a nswɛn.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa mbuur mpa awà ŋàlàkwikilà kan'kwen mudwa bɔr, wɛy nde ukyer abun! Un'tɔŋ wàbaal itàkal wun'kaar kà wàŋàteen anki unsà indiir abi. Nzam kàlabeel ntɔn bɛ làkäl unsà duu.
Wɛɛ, mbuur kan'tsul u mpem ande, ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akun'siinà a ngwal, unsà ukwen ande banswà, muwal an'kyän mukɔɔn atüüb ndür a ŋàtàntüüm ande, nde kan'kyer ubwaŋ.
Un'kaar wàŋàtüüb anà un'dim ande taaŋ lanswà awà nde anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Isàkal naa un'dim kan'kwà, nde kan'bulà wà nsaay mubääl mbuur ukwen nde, wɛɛ uboo a Mwol mpɛl.
« Byanswà bàkyàpà mbwo mukyer », wɛɛ kà bya byanswà anki ibye anà ndöŋ. « Byanswà bàkyàpà mbwo mukyer », wɛɛ kà bya byanswà anki byàfàtɔŋ.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur akwen mutɔn nkääl ayi, bi ifà aki kyatɛy, itàkal kà Ikööŋ a Nzam sye.
Wɛɛ umpal làfàkal bɛ u nköŋ, bɛ kà isaa a Mwol anki làfàdyà.

Kyakin mɛ alàkyään naa: akà mbuur mwɛy tɛy awà kan'kwo mutɛn u mbwo a Dweelà a Nzam naa: « Wɛy Yɛsu ukäl wàŋàküül! » Mbuur mwɛy tɛy kan'kwo mutɛn naa: « Mwol Yɛsu! », isàkɔɔn akal Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Isàkal naa itiir imwɛy kyà anà usaay, itiir byanswà byan'kab usaay aban. Isàkal naa itiir imwɛy bàmusyäŋà, itiir byanswà byan'saŋ anà nde.

Isàkal naa mɛ in'we anà kab mutà ngɔɔm, muyöb ngyee yanswà anà là ngyööb yanswà, isàkal naa mɛ in'we anà làkwikilà lanswà lan'kwo mutsum myɔŋ, wɛɛ isàkal naa mɛ ukwen batɛy, mɛ in'wà wà bunàbun!.
Apan, ntsüü waa isàyà, mpal usàfuur nde imwol akà Taa Nzam, ungö mudwa imfum kyanswà, ikɔ̈b kyanswà, ngwal yanswà.
Wɛɛ undiir wàtàtwɛb, wà ntsür a mbuur, ungö, mbuur a dweelà.
Abun, ilää a Nzam byanswà, byàmɛn « inye » a bya amu nde. Kyakin mbwo ande sye bi ifàtɛn naa « yabwɛy » akà Nzam ntɔn làkoo ande.
Nkye bi ifàsɛmà muswɛɛŋ bi ŋakwo? Itàkal naa nkye bi iwe anà mfun, asànaa bumwɛy, yà in'kaan muswɛɛŋ ntɔn bɛ, itàkal myàfà akà bɛ?.
Ntɔn bi ibye anà làkyän atub alà, waa bi iwe anà làkyän a mbɔɔn.
taaŋ lanswà ndür abi ye anà nkweel a Yɛsu ntɔn naa mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ukäl sye wàŋàmɛnà u ndür abi.
Kyakin isàkal naa bi kàkäl insil, bi kya kàkäl ntɔn Nzam, isàkal naa bi ikàmɛnà asànaa aŋun'yɛnà, yà ntɔn bɛ.

Nzam we anà ikɔ̈b mukàlayööl a an'kab a ngway mifà ifà, ntɔn u taaŋ lanswà anà unsà ndaa yanswà, bɛ làwɛl indiir làbà bɛ abyà mfun, anà làfàkal anà indiir aŋàsöönà ntɔn isal aŋàbwaŋ kyanswà.
Mɛ in'kwen anki mukal anà ifà mupà bɛ bɔɔmà unsà in'kaan amɛ.
Wɛɛ, mɛ in'we anà bɔɔmà muman naa an'kyän abɛ itäy anà ukwen abɛ ntɔn Klistɔ bàdiimà, asànaa ntäy kàkür nde Ɛva u mbwo a impeenà ande.
Ukɔɔn aler indiir byumwɛy, buur amɛ bilä a ilä bà nkyɛɛr ntɔn ikööŋ byanswà.

Yàlàkal naa mɛ in'kwen muswaŋ ngaal, mɛ kàlàkal anki ŋukɔŋ, ntɔn mɛ kàlàtɛn ndandaa. Wɛɛ mɛ an'tɔn mukyer abun, ntɔn mukɔɔn aman amu mɛ an'kyän aŋàsöön amà bàfàman ba itàkal bàfàwem ba akà mɛ.
Ntɔn mɛ, mɛ in'pà indiir amɛ byanswà anà mɛ ŋakwo wanswà ntɔn bɛ. Isàkal naa mɛ in'fàlakwen mbɔɔn, nkye mɛ bàyan'kwen ikikye?.
Ntɔn bi ikɔ̈b mumbäär ndandaa kyatɛy, wɛɛ bi iwe anà ikɔ̈b mukölà kya mpɛl.
Wɛɛ ŋàbawà, isàkal naa we anà mbuur mwɛy, itàkal bi, itàkal sye naa un'kyeey kan'fà du, kàmàlakyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ lànsöön anà la akwà kàlakyään bi, wɛy ŋakaan kun'käär!.
Ɔ insil a Angalàtyà! Nà kàlalɔ̈? Kyekà, Yɛsu Klistɔ awà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi bun'swɛŋ u mii a bɛ.
Klistɔ kitsuuŋ ntɔn bi ikäl baar a nsaay bàndandaa. Làkäl aŋàtsim, twon lan'fàkal uboo a mpay a isɔ.
Ntɔn ukwen a un'kɔɔn wanswà wà unsà ndaa mwɛy yi: « Ngye asàkwen un'tɔŋ angye asànaa ngye ŋakwo. ».
ilään, ngyöör a man, in'kyɔm, anà indiir a tub byabi. Mɛ amàlanaan an'tsü asànaa kàlakyään mɛ naa: baar bàfàsyääl bya, bàsàwal anki Imfum a Nzam.
Kyakin, u mbwo a ubwaŋ ande ntɔn bi amu Klistɔ Yɛsu, nde kàkwen muswaŋ u mbul a in'tye ayà isàyà, un'naaŋ a kölàköl wà kab a ngway ande.
Ya kàyan'fà anki unsà isal, ntɔn mbuur uswɛŋ ngaal.
Abun, twon lan'tüüb a baar a tub abà.
Ntɔn, akà mbuur mwɛy watɛy afàyiiŋ ndür ande ŋakwo, wɛɛ nde akyer afàdii anà afàlɔɔn ya ubwaŋàbwaŋ asànaa ufàkyer Klistɔ ntɔn Ikööŋ ande.
Undiiràwun wa mɛ amàlatööm awà, ntɔn nde kàlasam naa bi kà ibà aben anà kàlapɛ un'kanà.
Wɛɛ, itàkal naa mɛ an'tyaŋà asànaa man itàkal may udu a ibɔɔn anà isal a làkwikilà abɛ, mɛ in'wà unsà un'sak anà musaŋ anà bɛ banswà.
Ntɔn mɛ ban'kyɛy kà ilä kyànaan ungö a mböör amɛ. Mɛ in'wà un'nsi Isàlɛl, u mbil a Bɛnsàmɛn, Un'nsi Ebɛlyɔ mwan a Bebɛlyɔ, umfarisi unsà un'kɔɔn.
Atɔŋ, mumay, làsi an'kyän abɛ unsà indiir a ndandaa, byà ibyääl, byàbalàbal, byàŋàpɔŋà, byà ukwen, byàŋàsyäŋà, byàŋàbwaŋ, anà byàlàkoo.
Ikaswaŋà anki naa mɛ in'wàmuleŋ kab, wɛɛ mɛ in'kaleŋà naa bweel abɛ bàbɛy.

Twon lan'pà mbwo naa bàlatsüül mbar akà baar bàfàmɛnà naa ba bà baar a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà bàfàsà ngyamàkà akà akyeey. Ba bàŋàbilà afwee unsà imɛɛy aba ŋakwo. Ntɔn an'kyän a imbuur aba, ba bàŋàyam a uyɔl bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ.
Làyöb naa bɛ làsàwal làfur akà Mwol, la là kwal kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n nde ntɔn aŋikyɛɛl. Ntɔn Nkum a ndandaa làsyääl bɛ wà Klistɔ.
Ntɔn bɛ banswà làbà baan a pɛɛlà, baan a mwäänà: bi kibà baar a mpib anki, itàkal bà làpib anki.
Wɛy nde ukäl aŋàkwo muyaal ndwà ande ŋàkwo anà mukyer naa baan ande bàkäl unsà unkyeey anà làzir lanswà.
Lalan, kya mbuur uyöb anki muler ndwà ande ŋàkwo, nde ayàkwo aben muler Ikööŋ a Nzam?.
Yubwaŋ naa bàtwab atàsi, ungö, isàkal naa undiir un'be bàmɛn anki amu ba, apan waa ba bàsal.
Wɛy asɔ bàkäl anà unkyeey akà ankum aba unsà indiir byanswà, wɛy ba bapɛ un'sak anà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n asà mbaaŋ anà ba.
itàkal muyib akà undiir aba umwɛy, wɛɛ bàswɛŋ taaŋ lanswà naa ba bà bàlää, ntɔn mupà làkoo akà an'lɔɔŋ a Nzam, Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi.
Mɛ in'làkwen mukun'kaar tsütsü apà mɛ ntɔn nde kan'syääl kà ikal angye umpal in'wà mɛ u bɔlokà ntɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ.

Ntɔn baan abà bye anà undiir mwɛy wà un'tüüb, an'kil anà in'twaŋ, ifà imwɛy sye, Yɛsu kàbulà asànaa ba, nde kàbwäär ndür a imbuur. Abun, u mbwo a nkweel ande, nde kàkwaam ngwal a mbuur kàkäärà ukwà, iswaŋà naa Ileŋ.
Abun, wɛy bi idüül mubilà u ngyöör ayi, ntɔn akà mbuur mwɛy ukɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà unsà unkwɛɛm asànaa baar a Isàlɛl.
Itàkal naa nde kàkäl Mwan a Nzam, u mbwo a mpay kàmɛn nde, nde kàlɔŋàkà unkyeey.
Wɛɛ apanà, Yɛsu kan'wal isal aŋàsöön ubwaŋ, ntɔn nde wà mfurbo a nkwà aŋàsöön ubwaŋ, yan'bwaay udu a ilää aŋàsöön ubwaŋ.
Kyakin bàmbaar ntɛn mwɛy yàŋàkaab itiir byeel. Kyàtàtwɛb bàbeelà naa « ikal in'kyɛɛl », uboo byàkäl anà ikɔlà mutɔl mwinà, mɛsà anà mampà in'kyɛɛl.
Ntɔn, Klistɔ kàbilà anki uboo a idwà bàkyer kà an'kɔɔ a baar, idwà akyà ikwom kyàndandaa, wɛɛ nde kàbilà u kiin a du, ntɔn nde umɛnà apanà kusà a Nzam ntɔn bi.
Wɛɛ, imɛnà naa u mbwo a ibɔɔn abi, bàfàfuur man'be kà an'kyän mbul wanswà.
Mɛ in'fàsàyɔbà anki man'be aba anà ibii aba. ».
Isàkal naa bɛ ntaaŋàmbar làfàwal anki asànaa bàfàwal baan banswà, iswaŋà naa bɛ làbà baan a mbɔ̈, kà baan a bɔr anki.
Isàkal naa umwɛy uboo a bɛ an'yeerà matɛy, wɛy nde ulɔ̈m ma akà Nzam awà afàpà akà baar banswà u mpem aŋàbwaŋ ukɔɔn an'pɛl.
Kyakin, isàkal naa mbuur kan'wem ndaa a Nzam, wɛɛ nde ya usyääl anki, nde wà asànaa mbuur akalerà unsà làman anà kan'man ntabwey ande asànaa awà nde.
Atɔŋ amɛ, nkye un'te a fige afàbɔr mbɛŋ a ɔlivɛ, itàkal un'te a vin nkye afàbɔr mbɛŋ a fige? Ifuunà a an'dà a muŋ ikwo anki sye itwey an'dà a ntsà.
Làler: bi ifàkan aŋàmun'küünà. Bɛ làkyàwem làsaŋ a nkääŋ a mpem a Yɔb anà bɛ làkyàyöb ndaa kun'kyer Mwol, ntɔn Mwol wàŋàyɔl a mpem a ukwen anà ngyɛb.

Bɛ adim sye, làkäl anà nkääl a un'tüüb unsà ngwem anà làyöb nsöön a bwääl alye a akaar. Lasi akyay abe làzir, ntɔn ba, asànaa bɛ, ba bà aŋakwal a kab a ngway a mɔ̈ɔ̈, waa akà ndaa mwɛy ikɔ̈ɔ̈n asà lingyoomà uboo a ngyamàkà abɛ.
Wɛɛ ba bàsàmɛɛy nkyeer aba u mii a mbuur awà kan'kwo mutsul nsaŋ a baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà bàŋàkwà.
Làduub mii abɛ, làkäl unsà igyɛɛŋ! ntɔn ŋankir abɛ, ileŋ, wàmuyileŋ asànaa nkwee a umpɔr ayileŋ mbuur adyà.
Mbuur afàsyäl nswɛɛŋ ande wà wà Nzam, anà Nzam wà amu nde. Apan, bi ban'yöb naa nde wà uboo a bi, u mbwo a Dweelà kipɛ nde.
Ube banswà bà man'be, wɛɛ man'be manswà ifàsyen anki kà ukwà.
Wɛy duu làkäl anà ngye. Atɔŋ angye bàmapà mbɔr. Mbɔr akà asam, akà mbuur mbuur ukɔl.
Ngyɛb akà ba, ntɔn ba bàläb mbwo a Kayin. Ntɔn ukwen a ngim, ba bàbilà unsà ibii asànaa Balam, ba bàkü ntɔn un'tswe bwoor aba asànaa Kɔrɛ.
akà Nzam mwɛy un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi u mbwo a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ. Wɛy làkoo, uteer, unkaak a ngwal anà ikɔ̈b byàkäl anà nde, fà itaan, papanà, tii mbul a in'tye! Wöö wöö.
Mɛ un'tɔŋ abɛ Ywan, mbuur kàtüüb mbwo anà bɛ unsà ngyɛb, unsà imfum anà muküünà amu Yɛsu. Mɛ kàkäl kà isaŋ a Patmɔs ntɔn Ndaa a Nzam anà imbäl a Yɛsu.

Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'we anà pɛl làmwɛy ntɔn ngye: akà ngye bye anà baar bàkyànääm a an'lɔɔŋ a Balam awà kàlwɛŋà Balak naa nde baan a Isàlɛl kabwiy aben: nde kasiinà ba mudyà in'twaŋ bàfàlääm akɔl anà mukyer ipasàsɛ.
« Wɛɛ akà bɛ baar làbà u Tyatir mpa làbilà unsà nkääl a ube ayi anà làkɔ̈ɔ̈n aleŋ indübà a Satanà asànaa bàtɛɛnà ba, mɛ buur asin in'fàlakwɛy anki.

Taaŋ nsil alan, mɛɛn màkyer ani. Itiir imwɛy uboo a itiir kwem kyà bul kyàkyer abwabà, baar nsaab nsambwaar bàkü unsà ntɛɛr a mɛɛn ayi. Baar bàsäl bàbü matɛɛr anà bàpɛ làkoo akà Nzam a du.
Wɛɛ atɔŋ abi bàwɛl iböŋ udu a wa u mbwo a an'kil a mwan a un'kɔk anà u mbwo a ndaa bàtɛɛl ba imbäl. Ba bàkɔɔb mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba, ba bàkyey ukwà.

Kyakin, wɛy un'sak ukäl u du. Wɛy bɛ baar làfàkal u du làsäŋ! Wɛɛ ngyɛb akà bɛ u mɛɛn anà u ngyäl! Ntɔn ileŋ kyan'yàtyà akà bɛ, kyàŋàyɔl a un'fur a nkyɛl: Kya ikyàyöb naa taaŋ akya lan'sal ikikye. ».
Apan mɛ kàmɛn ntsür asin wàmutoo u mɛɛn. Wa kàkäl anà mbwaŋ, mbwaŋ yweel asànaa un'to a un'kɔk, wɛɛ wa kàtɛɛnà asànaa dalàgɔ.
Nde wàŋàbwaar kàzak aŋànwɛmà unsà an'kil. Ikɔb ande « Ndaa a Nzam ».
In'lwaŋ a aŋità a du myàyun'labà udu a mpoonà a pɛɛl, myaŋàbwaar ipfɛy a in'kà a ntsür kyà pɛɛl anà kyà tsɛk tsɛk.
Ibä kyàkäl kyàŋàtɔŋ a yaspe, anà bul làkäl làŋàtɔŋ a wɔl aŋàyir là tsɛk tsɛk asànaa talàtal.
« Mɛ, Yɛsu, mɛ kàtöm un'kyeey amɛ mutà imbäl a indiir abi akà bɛ ntɔn Ikööŋ. Mɛ, mɛ in'wà un'swɛy anà ywar a David, mbwaar afàpà in'ŋyäŋ u tutu. ».
Un'tɛɛl imbäl a indiir abi kan'tɛn naa: « Inye, mɛ in'wàmuyà agyä! » Yà abwɛy! Mwol Yɛsu, yà!.
